correctness.rationale: The displayed Weddle determinant was expanded as an exact symbolic identity over characteristic two. Squarefree coefficients vanish, giving J subset I; an exact independent quadratic-jet determinant is nonzero for every pairwise-distinct nonzero parameter tuple. Nakayama gives J=I. The fixed equations are exactly three squares, giving local length 8 and Hilbert function (1,3,3,1). The standalone checker was executed successfully.
